summary:
The plan is in plan.md. The building is a narrow SF Italianate row house. A teal false front sits on a dark sea-green garage base, with an angled bay stacked over the drive. A cream stair rises to a recessed porch with two columns.
Gold fish-scale bands and a burgundy frieze run under a deep cream bracketed cornice, with a small pediment on top. A low slate gable hides behind the parapet.
Party walls (ochre and pale blue neighbours) press in on both sides; the deck and long garden are at the back. All colours are teal/gold/burgundy/cream blocks checked with the toolkit; I avoided cyan_terracotta, which renders grey. Teal Italianate row house on a dark sea-green garage base: gold fish-scale bands, burgundy frieze, cream bracketed cornice and pediment, a full-height angled bay, and a cream stair up to a recessed two-column porch.
Fourteen rooms on four levels, with three stair runs and partitions with doorways. Six parts: shell, stairs and partitions, roof, front facade, openings, site.
elements.md has 36 elements, each with its blocks, coordinates, part and helper. plan.md has the palette, vocabulary, rooms and parts. All block ids are known.

concept_subject: A San Francisco Italianate "painted lady" on a steep city street, wedged between an ochre house downhill on the left and a taller pale-blue house uphill on the right. Above a dark sea-green garage base with a burgundy garage door, a slim three-storey teal-painted wooden front rises in horizontal siding. Its left half is a full-height angled bay window that hangs out over the driveway on cream corbels. The bay's corners are cream pilasters, and each storey has tall narrow sash windows with cream sills and hoods. On the right, a cream-trimmed stone stair with lantern newel posts climbs to a recessed entry porch: two slender cream columns, a burgundy double door with a transom. Above the porch are pairs of tall windows under small cream pediments. Two gold fish-scale shingle bands wrap the front and the bay at each floor line. At the top, a burgundy frieze with paired cream brackets carries a deep cream cornice. Above it a false-front parapet with gold fish-scale panels rises to a small cream pediment, hiding a low dark-slate gable roof with an iron crest and two brick chimneys. A tiny front garden of flowers sits behind a black iron fence beside the stair, with a street lamp at the curb. Behind the house, a spruce deck steps down from the kitchen's French doors into a deep garden with a flowering tree, a vegetable bed and wooden side fences.
concept_size: 16 wide, 50 deep (house 14x26), garage base + 3 storeys, about 20 tall
concept_palette: teal warped_planks body; gold bamboo_mosaic bands; burgundy crimson_planks and doors; cream smooth_quartz, quartz_pillar trim; dark_prismarine base; deepslate_tiles roof; bricks chimneys; yellow_terracotta and light_blue_terracotta neighbours; spruce deck; grass and flowers

Leaves every opening, the bay mouth z7 x2..5 y5..15 and all reserved cells as air.

parts.name: Stairs and partitions
parts.scope: frontStair, newel, three interior birch stairRuns (garage-main x12..13 z21..23 facing north; main-2nd z12..14 and 2nd-top z17..19 facing south), birch partitions and doorways per ROOMS, brick fireplace surrounds at the reserved firebox cells, well railings.

parts.name: Front facade
parts.scope: Corbels, bay posts and crown, bracketed cornice and frieze, parapet with coping, pediment with keystone, east pilaster, porch columns with capitals and arch spring, window hoods and sills on the front.

parts.name: Openings
parts.scope: Glass panes in every window opening front and back (sashWindow), crimson trapdoor garage door, front door pair with transom, French doors, back door, cellar light, back sills and hoods.

parts.name: Site
parts.scope: Iron fence and front garden bed, street lamp, back deck on posts with rail and stair, patio, back garden grass and path, garden tree, vegetable bed, garden fences.
